normal_rule: CFTC COT positions are normally Tuesday as-of and published Friday 15:30 ET; entry is 00:00 UTC on the first Tuesday after public availability.

fail_closed_exclusion_ranges.reason: 2018-2019 federal shutdown backlog; publication occurred after the frozen normal Tuesday entry for these reports
ION cyber incident backlog; CFTC explicitly delayed and sequentially reissued these reports after their frozen normal Tuesday entry

release_date_overrides.reason: CFTC historical special announcement; Monday report and Monday publication due federal holiday
CFTC historical special announcement; Juneteenth observance delayed Friday release to Monday

monday_asof_default_rule: If not in an exclusion or explicit release override, use the same-week Friday normal publication rule; this applies to 2023-07-03 and does not move the frozen Tuesday entry earlier than public availability.
protected_period_rule: An event is ineligible if its frozen entry or seven-calendar-day exit is after 2024-12-31. No 2025 price is fetched or used.
